official_skills.notes: The repository holds 175 skills across languages; the installer runs a selection wizard. Install only the -py skills that apply, not the whole collection.

modern-python, property-based-testing and insecure-defaults were confirmed on 2026-08-27. The static-analysis skill name was not confirmed against the repository listing - verify before recommending that one specifically.

FastAPI ships a skill inside its own repository at .agents/skills/fastapi rather than in a dedicated skills repo. The install route was not confirmed on 2026-08-27; check whether it is picked up automatically from the installed package before recommending a command.

gap_map.why_it_matters: Router scaffolding produces endpoints fast. Nothing decides which of them carry business rules worth testing, so the suite ends up asserting that FastAPI can serialize a model.
gap_map.filled_by: LambdaTest/agent-skills#pytest-skill for authoring, trailofbits/skills#property-based-testing for invariants

gap_map.why_it_matters: The listed skills stop at the request/response boundary. Schema changes are the single most common source of irreversible production damage in this stack.
gap_map.fallback: The mentor requires every schema change to ship with a reversible migration and a plan for the deploy window.

testing.notes: Prefer FastAPI's TestClient for integration tests over mocking the router - it exercises dependency overrides, validation and serialization, which is where the real bugs are. Read pyproject.toml for the configured runner and typechecker before assuming these commands.

growth_thresholds.extract_service_layer: an endpoint function exceeds 40 lines, which means business logic has leaked into the transport layer
growth_thresholds.extract_package: >=2 features import the same internal module

dead_code_risks: Endpoints registered by decorator and reachable only over HTTP
Pydantic models referenced only as type annotations in signatures
Alembic migration modules discovered by directory scan
Dependencies wired through Depends() with a callable reference
Celery or background tasks dispatched by string name
Plugins loaded through entry points declared in pyproject.toml
